title: Cover remaining show window continuation behavior under intervening writes
outcome: Cover remaining show window continuation behavior under intervening writes
acceptance: An ordinary observations continuation after a newer same-run source report returns every older original once in order and counts the appended report as newer.
History and notes-with-gates continuations after newer matching records return the announced older rows once in order.
A cursor with a genuine boundary but a changed older-row count is refused.
An evaluation continuation shows an older row reassessed using evidence added since the previous page.
